transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to discuss the proposed six-Saturday credit-recovery program for Algebra I. Before I can sign off on the request, we need to run through our standard procurement and implementation check. I'd like to hear from our instructional coach and finance coordinator regarding the program details we have so far -- 20 seats in a regular classroom, with the instructor and funding source still pending. Let's start by addressing those open items.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share some important information before we proceed. I collected student confirmations this week, and exactly 14 students will attend the program. Each of those students must complete work on the district learning platform during the sessions. The regular classroom listed in the request has no student computers, but our computer lab has 14 networked workstations that would meet this need. I have not yet updated the submitted request with these details.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share some critical information from the grant award letter I reviewed this week. The award letter for the credit-recovery grant permits only a certified mathematics teacher to lead the sessions, and it provides exactly $2,400 for this program, calculated as six sessions at a $400 instructor stipend. I have not yet entered these restrictions into the approval record, so we need to ensure the instructor selected is a certified math teacher and that the funding is drawn from this grant source.
transcript.speaker: A3
